paper_title: Pulsar Polarization Array Limits on Ultralight Axion-like Dark Matter
coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1 (Chern-Simons coupling), plotted as log10(g_agamma/GeV^-1)
notes: Pulsar Polarization Array analysis of Parkes PTA DR3 constraining the axion-photon Chern-Simons coupling g_agamma via cosmic birefringence. Text states best global limits ~10^-13.5 to 10^-12.2 GeV^-1 over mass range 10^-22 to 10^-21 eV, with ρ0=0.4 GeV/cm^3. Data points here encode the two stated endpoints (10^-13.5=3.16e-14 at 1e-22 eV, 10^-12.2=6.31e-13 at 1e-21 eV); full curve is in Fig. 2 but not tabulated. Limits scale ~m_a for m_a >~ 1/Tobs. 95% upper limits. | selector: figure_vision over text (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 2, 0, 0.8, 48)) | Vision: Traced the red Full-corr solid curve as the PPPA limit boundary. Limits scale linearly with m_a above 1/T_obs and as m_a^-2 below. Sharp peaks at m_a~1e-22 eV and m_a>1e-19.4 eV (one day timescale) noted as likely due to imperfect noise modeling. y-axis multiplier not present; values read directly from log10 scale.
